photo.credit: NASA / ESA / Hubble · Hubble's galaxy-morphology classification diagram (the 'tuning fork' — taxonomy introduced 1926, diagram 1936). Edwin Hubble's original taxonomy — ellipticals, spirals (barred + unbarred), and irregulars — is still the working vocabulary almost a century later, with major refinements.
